Catalogue of Lattices archive entry `union:50` names `A2`.

Usually called the hexagonal lattice (see SPLAG); sometimes called the triangular lattice.

Catalogue of Lattices archive entry `union:82` names `A2*`.

Dual to A2, also equivalent to A2
